title: Chapter 1: The Merchant and His Daughters
chineseTitle: 第 1 章：商人与他的女儿们

paragraphs.en: There was once a very rich merchant, who lived in a grand mansion in the city with his six children, three sons and three daughters. Being a man of sense and broad vision, he spared no expense for their education, providing them with all kinds of excellent tutors in music, literature, and languages. His three daughters were extremely handsome, but the youngest was admired above all. When she was little, everyone praised her sweet temper and called her 'The Little Beauty'; as she grew into a lovely young woman, the name 'Beauty' stuck with her, which excited bitter jealousy in her elder sisters.
paragraphs.zh: 曾经有一位非常富有的商人，他和他的六个孩子（三个儿子和三个女儿）住在城里的一栋豪宅里。作为一位明智且有远见的人，他在教育上不惜重金，为他们请了音乐、文学和语言等各种优秀的家庭教师。他的三个女儿都极其漂亮，但最小的那个最受人赞赏。当她还是个小女孩时，每个人都赞扬她温和的脾气，叫她“小美女”；随着她长成一位可爱的年轻女子，“贝儿”这个名字就一直伴随着她，这在她的姐姐们心中激起了强烈的嫉妒。

paragraphs.en: The two eldest sisters were filled with pride and vanity because of their immense wealth. They gave themselves ridiculous airs, refused to visit other merchants' daughters, and would socialize only with nobility and titled persons. They spent their days attending lavish balls, grand parties, and the opera, constantly ridiculing their youngest sister because Beauty preferred to spend her quiet hours at home reading classic books or practicing her harpsichord.
paragraphs.zh: 两个大姐姐因为巨大的财富而充满了骄傲与虚荣。她们摆出可笑的架子，拒绝拜访其他商人的女儿，并且只与贵族和有封号的人交往。她们把日子花在参加奢华的舞会、盛大的聚会和歌剧上，并不断嘲笑她们最小的妹妹，因为贝儿更喜欢在家里安静地度过时光，阅读经典书籍或练习大键琴。
